Allan is a frank and cheerful young man who maintains high ideals. He is well-liked by people both young and old.

## History

Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with his wife while on their honeymoon as the town's new minister. During a tea visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), he and his wife were served a cake accidentally flavored with liniment instead of vanilla.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan is the minister's wife and a trusted confidante to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their bond began on a mortifying note when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served Mrs. Allan a cake flavored with liniment, but Mrs. Allan offered gentle comfort and assured her it was an honest mistake. Over time, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frequently visits Mrs. Allan to share her joys and turn to her for guidance during times of deep grief, such as after Matthew's death. They also enjoy walking home together to discuss their shared ideals, teaching mistakes, and the true nature of friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P34](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0034), +20 more_
